# IT Consultis (ITC)

> > IT Consultis (ITC) delivers digital transformation, eCommerce, and enterprise solutions across China and APAC markets, specializing in WeChat ecosystems, customer data platforms, and B2B/D2C strategies for global brands.

IT Consultis serves multinational brands including LVMH, Unilever Prestige, Coty, and The Hour Glass with China-specific digital solutions spanning WeChat Mini Programs, WeCom clienteling, CDP implementation, and headless CMS development. The firm operates across Shanghai, Singapore, Melbourne, and Saigon, focusing on private traffic strategies and PIPL-compliant data management.

## Key Topics

- Digital Transformation in China & APAC
- WeChat Mini Programs & WeChat Pay
- WeCom (WeChat Work) Enterprise Solutions
- Customer Data Platform (CDP) & PIPL Compliance
- Private Traffic & Social Commerce
- D2C & B2B eCommerce Strategies
- Luxury Brand Digital Experiences
- Headless CMS & Drupal Development
- Cross-Border Payment Solutions
- Social CRM & Clienteling
- China Market Entry & Localization
- TenPay Global Checkout
- Tourism & Hospitality Digital Strategy
- Multi-Market APAC Deployment

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Digital Transformation Services in China, APAC, and Globally](https://it-consultis.com/services): ITC's digital transformation services across China & APAC markets
- [Customer Data Platform (CDP) Consulting & Execution for China](https://it-consultis.com/insights/customer-data-platform-china-consulting-execution): CDP consulting & execution services for China market with PIPL compliance
- [Global Website Design & Development Services](https://it-consultis.com/insights/global-website-design-development-consulting-execution): Global website design & development services with headless architecture
